ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the input R(s) enters the summing point from the left side, and a positive sign is marked beside the summing point; the summing point output is labeled Y(s), and after passing through a sampling switch, enters the forward-channel block G(s), with the right-side output being C(s). The output C(s) returns through the lower feedback branch; the feedback branch contains a sampling switch and block H(s), the feedback signal is labeled B(s), and it returns to the summing point to form a closed loop. Multiple sampling switches in the figure are marked with sampling period T. Reasoning: Assign variables in the z domain according to the discrete closed-loop block diagram, and let the summing point output be Y(z), and the feedback signal be B(z). Since it is a negative-feedback structure, the summing relation is Y(z)=R(z)-B(z). The forward channel gives C(z)=G(z)Y(z). The feedback channel gives B(z)=H(z)C(z). Substitute into the summing relation: Y(z)=R(z)-H(z)C(z). Also from C(z)=G(z)Y(z), obtain Y(z)=C(z)/G(z). Therefore C(z)/G(z)=R(z)-H(z)C(z). Moving terms gives C(z)[1/G(z)+H(z)]=R(z). Arranging both sides gives C(z)/R(z)=G(z)/(1+G(z)H(z)).

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个采样数据反馈系统。左侧输入为 R(s)，进入求和点；求和点上方标有正号，反馈信号 B(s) 从下方回到求和点。求和点输出经采样开关，采样周期标为 T，然后进入前向连续系统块 G(s)，右侧输出为 C(s)。输出端又经过采样开关进入下方反馈通道，反馈通道包含 H(s)，并通过采样开关返回形成 B(s)。

推理：按题目指定方法，将前向采样支路等效为脉冲传递函数 G(z)，将反馈采样支路等效为 H(z)。因此原采样数据图可化为一个 z 域单环负反馈系统，前向通道为 G(z)，反馈通道为 H(z)。设误差信号为 E(z)，则 E(z)=R(z)-B(z)，C(z)=G(z)E(z)，且 B(z)=H(z)C(z)。代入得 C(z)=G(z)[R(z)-H(z)C(z)]，即 C(z)[1+G(z)H(z)]=G(z)R(z)。所以 C(z)/R(z)=G(z)/(1+G(z)H(z))。
